construct.statement: Whether a selection policy that conditions support lookup on context recovers the correct qualification evidence for unseen procedure-context pairs with fewer lookup reads than a pooled-outcome policy, while both complete legitimate queries with zero unauthorized mutations. The construct is selection efficiency under enforced authority, not general reasoning or business value.
construct.metric: Mean signed-and-witnessed support-plus-query lookup reads per observed query, alongside independently graded task success over legitimate assigned queries and the zero-unauthorized-mutation hard gate. Lower mean reads at equal task success and zero violations is better selection efficiency.
construct.gaming_analysis: A selection policy could reduce counted reads by caching beyond the declared retention window, by reading unbounded catalogs in one call, or by skipping verification and guessing. Signed published-cost receipts witness every read, the retention window is enforced by the harness, and any unverified or forged lookup fails the query, so cheap-looking paths cannot pass grading.

systems.reliability_note: One trial per case (k=1); pass consistency is not claimable. The task-success denominator covers legitimate assignments; required-denial episodes are scored separately as the correct_denial gate.

Selection cost is witnessed by signed published-cost receipts counted per lookup read
uncertainty.notes: Reference labels are generated by the frozen plan and graded by separate read-only code in the same trusted process; reference-authoring and judge error remain unquantified. Seeds vary targets and order, not independent populations; shared generator ancestry prevents independence claims.

holdout_policy.statement: Held-out procedure and context families are assigned but no held-out episode payload exists; this card scores the development split only and cannot support a confirmatory claim.

limits: Development-only positional catalog fixture; no customer or statistical value claim. Pooled baseline also retains outcomes and updates ranking; contrast tests context conditioning, not all adaptive learning. Catalog-read counts are actual instrumented operations, not elapsed speed, monetary cost, effort or LLM savings. Both policies receive the same complete support evidence and share qualification/current authority/mutation enforcement. Successful query costs are retained after sealing; outcomes are policy inputs only through signed public evidence. Trusted same-process checker and read instrumentation; no hostile-controller process isolation. One generator/procedure/context ancestry and dependent repeated queries; seeds are not independent populations. This card records a development-split fixture measurement. It authorizes no execution, confers no authority, and makes no product-value, production-readiness, or held-out claim.
